"Dorcas Second wife of Jacob Pugh Died Dec. 27, 1858 Aged About 75 Yrs."

Dorcas Glasgow Pugh was born 8 Jan 1783 in Pasquotank Co., NC; she married Jacob Pugh 18 May 1806 in Randolph Co., NC. Dorcus was the daughter of Caleb Glasgow, a soldier in the American Revolution.
